newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal 5-yr bond yields seen easier. [CORRECTED 09:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal 5-yr bond yields seen easier. [CORRECTED 09:15 GMT]

text.p: The average weighted rate at the Portuguese Treasury's sale of 20 billion escudos of five-year bonds (OT) on Tuesday was seen easing to 6.45-50 percent, down from 6.8412 percent at the previous sale on October 22, analysts said.
The result would be in line with secondary market levels and the only doubt was whether the Treasury would place the full 20 billion escudos, they added.
The Treasury will announce the results at around 1100 GMT.
"The auction will be in line with the secondary market and will be between 6.45 and 6.50 percent. These levels reflect confidence that Portugal will be included in Monetary Union," said one trader.
The March 2001 OT closed at 108.27 on Monday for a yield of 6.48 percent, 16 basis points above (corrects from beneath) the Spanish equivalent.
